players.product: Ceramic housings and aluminium nitride ceramic substrates for optical communication modules

quarterly_data.quarter: Sinopack results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (05-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Executive deputy general manager (acting general manager) Liang Xiangyang (2025 annual and Q1 2026 results briefing): the booming optical-communication market has lifted orders for its optical-communication products; electronic-ceramics orders on hand are ample and the company is expanding capacity to secure delivery; the electronic ceramic housing project is being built on plan and capacity is being released step by step. Q1 2026 growth came mainly from fast demand growth for electronic ceramics, with scale effects and cost advantages showing. Its 1.6Tbps products are already in volume supply (the annual report's 1.6T multilayer thin-film substrate R&D project refers to certain new 1.6T products).

quarterly_data.quarter: Sinopack results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (05-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CFO, deputy general manager and board secretary Dong Hui (results briefing): Q1 2026 gross margin fell mainly because the fast-growing electronic-ceramics products carry slightly lower margins than other segments, and because rising gold and non-ferrous metal prices pressured ceramic-housing costs; as capacity is released further and scale effects show, the CFO expects electronic-ceramics gross margin to keep rising. Product pricing is market-based, set according to the market and raw-material prices. Contract liabilities were RMB 4317.88 ten-thousand in the 2025 annual report and RMB 1086.51 ten-thousand at Q1 2026.

quarterly_data.quarter: Sinopack results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (05-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman Bu Aimin (results briefing), explaining why the planned capacity of its GaN projects was scaled down: the projects were set up in 2022 during the fast 5G base-station build-out, which moved from fast growth to a plateau from 2024; 5G-A base stations are evolving toward MIMO architectures, changing the form of GaN power-amplifier demand; and Bowei's customers now favour low-cost plastic-packaged devices over ceramic-packaged ones, reducing its capacity needs. He said Bowei has developed key RF chip and device technologies and products for direct-to-phone low-earth-orbit satellite communications and is advancing their industrialisation according to user demand.
